prose.subject: Invoice INV-45664 & Payout Account Update
prose.body:
Dear Maya,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to share our latest invoice, INV-45664, for the recent creative deliverables. The total amount due is 1762.50 USDC. You can find the document attached for your review and processing.

Additionally, I wanted to inform you of a small administrative update on our end. Dunmore Media has recently onboarded a new treasury management tool to streamline our disbursement processes. As part of this transition, we have established a new payout account: dunmoremedia92-treasury.testnet. We have already linked this identifier to our primary domain, dunmore-media.example, to ensure consistency in future billing cycles.

Please update your records with this new account string for any subsequent payments. This change takes effect immediately and does not impact the terms of our current engagement. The account is fully verified and ready to receive funds securely.

If you have any questions regarding the invoice details or the new account setup, please feel free to reach out. We appreciate your continued partnership with Bramblecote Studio and look forward to our continued collaboration.

Best regards,

Maya Okafor
Dunmore Media
